summary: The port is complete and faithful — function inventory and all six post-render/substrate call sites match HelmCharts argument-for-argument — and I reproduced the handover independently: 9 elements and 16 relations id-for-id against the live published dataset, byte-identical over two runs, one gap line, exit 0, with seven mutations showing the 33 tests are live. Four advisory findings, none of them fix work: the app name comes from Chart.yaml where Argo takes it from the registry path, a deferred cross-producer ref is reported outside the `gap:` form, the repo manifest's component description still names one command, and two new preconditions fail with a traceback.

findings.summary: The namespace and every element id derive from chart/Chart.yaml's name, while Argo builds <app>-<stage> from the registry path segment; a divergence re-mints the whole model on a green run.
An unresolvable cross-producer ref prints as `deferred (cross-producer, unresolved):` rather than the `gap:` line the generated-producer contract says is the only form ever read.
.kubecoder/project.yaml's aac-tools description still enumerates arch-validate alone after this phase added the image's second command.
hook_parameters' origin remote and chart_metadata's chart/Chart.yaml fail with an unhandled traceback where the sibling annotation-layer precondition fails with a sentence.
